title: What are Modules in Node.js?
overview: Modules are reusable blocks of code that can be imported and used in different parts of a Node.js application. They help organize and maintain code.

title: Core Modules
overview: Node.js provides built-in modules that can be used without installing additional packages.

example.title: Core Module Examples
example.content:
fs → File System
http → Create Server
path → File Paths
os → Operating System

title: Importing Modules
overview: Modules can be imported using require() in CommonJS syntax to access their functionality.

title: Creating Custom Modules
overview: Developers can create their own modules by exporting functions, objects, or variables and importing them into other files.

title: module.exports and exports
overview: Node.js uses module.exports and exports to share code from one module to another.

title: ES Modules in Node.js
overview: Modern Node.js applications can use ES Module syntax with import and export statements.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about Node.js modules, core modules, custom modules, exporting, importing, and modern ES module syntax.
